title.narrative: Life-Saving Multi-Sectoral FSA, GBV and WASH Response for Vulnerable IDPs and Host Communities in As-Sweida and Aleppo Governorate (Priority 1)

description.narrative: ltpgtThrough a coordinated multi-sectoral approach, Norwegian Church Aid (NCA) and its partners will address urgent humanitarian needs in Food Security and Agriculture (FSA), Gender-Based Violence (GBV), and Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (WASH) in Milh (As-Sweida Governorate) and Jabel Saman (Aleppo Governorate). The project targets Internally Displaced Persons (IDPs) and host communities, aligning with OCHA Strategic Priority 1 and based on recent assessments by NCA and its partners.ltbrgtIn Milh, NCA will directly implement WASH and FSA activities, while GBV services will be delivered by its implementing partner GOPA/DERD. In Jabel Saman, NCA will lead WASH interventions, and its implementing partner EPDC will implement GBV services. This project builds on existing operational presence and community trust in the selected locations.ltbrgtThe project contributes to HRP Strategic Objectives SO1 and SO3 and supports the following cluster objectives:ltbrgtFSA/CO2 CO3: Support household self-reliance through emergency agricultural inputs and rehabilitation of irrigation infrastructure. In Milh, one irrigation borehole will be rehabilitated to revive agriculture affected by drought. Farmers will receive training and cash-based support to purchase inputs, promoting household food security and build resilience.ltbrgtGBV/CO3: Improve access to quality, lifesaving GBV services for women, girls, and at-risk individuals. GBV response and prevention services will be delivered through a an already established and functional Women and Girls Safe Spaces (WGSS) in Milh and Jabel Saman communities ltbrgtfor a duration of ten months. Activities include case management, referrals, psychosocial support, vocational training, and outreach to challenge harmful norms and systemic gender inequalities. The GBV component will also include integration of GBV risk mitigation measures across NCA WASH and FSA and partner activities.ltbrgtWASH/CO1: Save lives and reduce protection risks by improving access to essential WASH services. In Milh, this includes rehabilitating water infrastructure and solarizing pumping stations. In Jabel Saman, sanitation networks will be rehabilitated in Bustan Al-Qaser, Al Kallasa, As-Sukkari, and Al-Ansari neighborhoods. Hygiene promotion activities will be tailored to local needs, including awareness sessions and distribution of essential WASH NFIs to vulnerable groups.ltbrgtIn summary, the project will directly:ltbrgt1. Restore and protect livelihoods through irrigation rehabilitation and emergency agricultural inputs in Milh, reaching 250 HH (1250 family members).ltbrgt2. Deliver lifesaving GBV services to reduce protection risks and improve access to safe, confidential support for women, girls, and at-risk individuals, reaching 4810 beneficiaries.ltbrgt3. Provide essential WASH services to reduce disease risk and uphold dignity in Milh and Jabel Saman, reaching 18270 beneficiaries. In total, the project will reach 21,370 direct and indirect beneficiaries.ltbrgtThe project leverages NCA’s technical oversight and partner capacity, access and community trust and presence to ensure high-quality, lifesaving, ethical, and sustainable service delivery. The project will be implemented by experienced national and expatriate staff with sectoral expertise. When necessary, NCA will draw support technical expertise from its Head Office. NCA will deploy field staff in project locations overseeing day-day project implementation and to provide technical guidance and support to partners. Additional support from NCA officers in Damascus and Aleppo will be provided. Monitoring and reporting will be conducted through NCA’s MEAL and Finance departments to ensure compliance with donor requirements. All activities will be implemented using a rights-based, do-no-harm approach, with strict adherence to accountability, inclusion, and protection protocols.ltbrgtlt/pgt
